description: There is only a small number of places which remain intact today that were built by indentured Indians in Trinidad. Built in 1885, the Avocat Mud House Museum, located at 176 Siparia Old Road, Avocat is one of these historical treasures. Listed opening hours: By appoinments only. Verify access, opening times and any fees with the site before travelling.
